Coram : R.F. NARIMAN, ANIRUDDHA BOSE, V. RAMASUBRAMANIAN
Electricity Act, 2003 – ss.86(1)(f) and ss.37, 42, 158 – Appellant has four high tension electricity connections for its units at Chanderiya, Debari, Aghucha and Dariba, for which four contracts with the respondent were entered into for purchase of electricity – a captive power plant at Chanderiya – It entered into three open access agreements dtd. 10.03.05 with the respondent – Dispute arose as to the unscheduled interchange charges payable under Clauses 8 & 9 of the agreements – By orders passed by the Rajasthan Electricity
Decision Date : 04-12-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9212/2019 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 3 Judges
